references.text: The Lord had already said that the people were too many, and this verse continues the process of reducing the army
Describes the actual test at the water which God mentions in verse 4, where the soldiers were separated based on how they drank
God tested Israel in the wilderness to know their heart, just as he tested Gideon's men by the water
Uses the same Hebrew word for refining/testing (צרף), where God refines his people like silver
Jeremiah describes how God sets the prophet to test the people, with the same concept of purification and testing
God purifies his remnant through fire, parallel to how Gideon's army was purified and reduced to a faithful remnant
The Lord tests hearts, the same theme as God testing Gideon's men to separate out the worthy
